meta.objective: Run a custom deep-search-style planning workflow for judge-gym V4 that produces a concrete refactor plan for evidence/window schemas, provider/runtime abstraction for Anthropic and OpenRouter, experiment and prompt-surface generalization, and a self-contained V4 paper/study specification with phased execution deliverables.

decisions.statement: Treat V4 as a self-contained study with broader provider support and general evidence imports, not as a narrow pilot continuation.
Prioritize the evidence/window data model before transport and prompt-layer changes.
